kept_from_v25: the RX revision with its UINT32_MAX saturation and drop accounting, which host freshness logic and the durable replay floors depend on
gate_crc_t and the CRC snapshot taken under a masked interrupt
the 32 slot ring, because dual traffic roughly doubles the RX rate and mac_gate's ring held 8
taken_from_mac_gate: the context classification and header carried on each record
the configuration generation stamped onto each record
hardware captures of the ACK sequence via PPI
union.field_names_preserved: revision, session, time_us, length, mac, rssi, lqi, ack_started, ack_completed, deadline_miss are unchanged in name and meaning, so tests/firmware_cli.c and tests/scan_replay.c compile unchanged and leave the new fields zero. Verified by compiling both harnesses without editing either.
union.two_statistics_structs_are_deliberate: gate_stats_t counts classification of complete frames as recorded; dual_stats_t in dual_context.c counts admission decisions taken during BCC on a partial header and the reasons an ACK was suppressed. One says what arrived, the other says what was answered.

hardware_timing.method: PPI captures into TIMER3, not software clock reads

ppi.CH0: RADIO EVENTS_CRCOK  -> TIMER3 CAPTURE[0], the RX instant
ppi.CH1: RADIO EVENTS_TXREADY -> TIMER3 CAPTURE[1], ACK start
ppi.CH2: RADIO EVENTS_PHYEND -> TIMER3 CAPTURE[2], ACK end
ppi.CH3: RADIO EVENTS_ADDRESS -> TIMER3 CAPTURE[3], ACK address

hardware_timing.why_it_matters: gate A has to measure the RX to ACK turnaround, and USB arrival time or a software read after interrupt latency cannot do it
hardware_timing.time_us_change: time_us is now the CRCOK capture rather than a software read taken afterwards. The same instant, measured more precisely; in host-test builds it remains whatever the mock sets.

integration_bug_found_and_prevented.what: V25's gate_hw_now_us() performed a software TASKS_CAPTURE[0] and read CC[0]; mac_gate's PPI captures the CRCOK instant into that same CC[0]
integration_bug_found_and_prevented.consequence_if_merged_naively: any foreground clock read would silently overwrite the hardware RX timestamp, corrupting exactly the measurement the first hardware gate depends on
integration_bug_found_and_prevented.fix: software clock reads moved to TASKS_CAPTURE[4] and CC[4]; CC[0..3] belong to the PPI captures. TIMER3 on this part has six capture registers.
integration_bug_found_and_prevented.guard_added: _Static_assert on NRF_802154_PPI_CHANNELS_USED_MASK so a driver that starts using PPI 0..3 fails the build rather than the measurement
